title.english: Chapter 1: How the Divine Revelation started being revealed to Allah's Messenger
title.arabic: باب كَيْفَ كَانَ بَدْءُ الْوَحْىِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم (1)

detail.english: And the Statement of Allah جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ: "Verily, We have sent the revelation to you (O Muhammad ﷺ) as We sent the revelation to Noah and the Prophets after him." (V.4:163)
detail.arabic: "وَقَوْلُ اللَّهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ: إِنَّا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ كَمَاأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى نُوحٍ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ "

english.text: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions..."

arabic.chain: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ ...

title.english: Chapter 2: Belief in the Oneness of Allah

detail.english: Allah is One, without any partners.

english.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah has ninety-nine names..."
